title: Ensemble learning predicts early perampanel response in children with epilepsy
summary: In a retrospective cohort of 325 children with epilepsy, an ensemble model using seven covariates reached a test-set AUC of 0.861 (95% CI 0.727-0.963) and accuracy of 0.892, with external validation AUC 0.798 (95% CI 0.668-0.900). SHAP identified the number of antiseizure medications, perampanel maintenance dose and CYP3A4 inducers as the main predictors of non-response. Confidence intervals are wide and the external cohort size is not in the abstract.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine learning on clinical covariates with SHAP interpretation
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University
